title: Supply Chain Finance Modeller
description: Model supply chain finance programme economics. Compare reverse factoring, dynamic discounting, and inventory finance. Outputs cost-benefit waterfall, supplier working capital benefit, and SCF programme design memo. Client-side. Zero PII.
